_note: Scripts every page runs, around its own list in pages.json (scripts): before, then the page's, then after. Bundled, `before` and `shared` (which every page lists among its own) become js/site.bundle.js, which every page shares, and the rest the page's own js/page-<page>.bundle.js. See .eleventy/bundles.mjs.
_globalsNote: Modules (js/*.mjs) whose exports the page's classic scripts still read as a global. Remove an entry once nothing reads that global.
